canonical_statement: For categories C and D and a functor G : D -> C, if D has all limits, G preserves limits whose diagram and morphism universes are vD, and G satisfies the vD-small solution-set condition, then G is a right adjoint (equivalently, G has a left adjoint).
domain_and_universes: universes vC vD uC uD; C : Type uC with Category.{vC} C; D : Type uD with Category.{vD} D; G : CategoryTheory.Functor D C; Prop in Lean universe 0
minimal_import_evidence: The sole direct import defines SolutionSetCondition and exposes the right-adjoint vocabulary and all limit interfaces used by the target. The legacy Limits and HomologySequenceLemmas imports are unnecessary for this statement.
alternate_encoding: TypeclassGeneralRightAdjointTarget uses HasLimits and PreservesLimitsOfSize as instance binders, matching the pinned mathlib theorem interface. The checked iff transports both directions without invoking the adjoint functor theorem.

degenerate_case_policy: No nonempty, small-object, locally-small-object, well-powered, coseparating, or equal-universe assumptions are added. Empty categories and large object universes remain syntactically in scope; any impossible hypothesis combination is handled by implication. Smallness is exactly SolutionSetCondition.{vD}, whose indexing type lies in Type vD.
